profile.headline:
Senior Software Engineer at Intuit | Ex-ADP |
 Agentic AI & LLM Systems | AI Skills . MCP · Langfuse · MLFlow | Staff & EM Track | Staff Engineer & Engineering Manager Roles
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer, Senior AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Solutions Architect, Agentic AI , AI Skill Engineer & Certified Scrum Product Owner(CSPO), Forward Deployed Engineer

I build AI systems that ship — from LLM evaluation pipelines and agentic workflows to production ML deployments serving millions of users.  At Intuit, I work across AI/ML engineering across Agentic AI, Marketing Automation, and LLM Services — including MCP/ Skills Server Development, and a full AI Service Layer on AWS/GCP. Currently I lead Langfuse/MLFlow-based eval frameworks for Agents. I've taken ownership of end-to-end ML pipelines from Kubeflow data processing to GCP model deployment.  Previously at ADP, I architected OCR and document classification pipelines that pushed model accuracy to ~95%, reducing manual review overhead at scale.  What sets me apart: I operate at the intersection of hands-on engineering and systems thinking. I've mentored engineers, driven cross-functional AI initiatives, and contributed to platform-level decisions — the skill set of a Staff Engineer or Engineering Manager, not just an individual contributor. Core stack: Python · AWS (SQS, SNS, S3, EC2) · GCP · Kubeflow · Langfuse · MLFlow · LLM APIs · Agentic AI Frameworks.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer(AI/ML Engineer / AgenticAI)
positions.description:
● AI Skill Development for Agentic Workflows
● LLM/Agent Evaluation using Langfuse and MLFlow
● Marketing Agent Development 
● AI Service Layer Development using AWS stack
● Intuit Mailchimp Prompt Engineering services
● Kubeflow Data Pipeline Development 
● Classical ML Model Deployment on GCP Stack
positions.insights: Skills: Prompt Engineering · Large Language Models (LLM) · Agentic AI Development · Langfuse · Model Context Protocol (MCP) · LLM Evaluation

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
● Pioneered Data Retraining Pipeline for Extraction and Classification ML models which can improve their accuracy upto about 95 percent
● Architected ML/OCR pipeline in cloud using AWS technologies like SQS,SNS,S3,EC2,STS
● Worked on backend java api for file transfers from Data lakes & S3 storages for retraining ML model
● Utilized IVR data to perform descriptive & predictive analytics for customer intent prediction
● Coordinated RPA automation for Document Classification and Data Extraction pipeline

positions.title: Associate Application Developer
positions.description:
● Constructed Machine learning models for performing OCR on Federal Documents
● Advanced ELK stack to design ML visualization dashboards for the leadership
● Programmed Gateway server using Java Spring Boot and Swagger to test different Data Models

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant (Networking and Data Analysis)
Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
● Used IBM Cognos to build reporting dashboard for the service analytics team.
● Worked with MS-SQL ,Oracle SQL & python to extract & preprocess data used for business metrics. 
● Documented the streamline flow of ADP’s Chatbot system to detect data inconsistency and flaws. 
● Strategized AI transformation plans in the service analytics team to improve customer experience.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant (Operating Systems, Parallel and Distributed Computing)
positions.description:
● Worked on the research project Funded By Department of Defence(USA).
● Used Cloudsuite Benchmarks and Iperf Benchmarks for initial testing of the server performance.
● Worked with Docker container using MacVlan to run Cloudsuite tests for physical server machines.
● Performed Memcached/Redis Network Performance Benchmarks for X-86 and ARM Servers.
● Worked with Python,R, Shell/Bash Script and Gnuplot Libraries in-order to analyze the benchmark results.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
● Developed the real-time backend for the companies web application using
Node.js and Express.js.
● Worked on different features involving Authentication, Realtime data
parsing and also worked on social media features for its applications such as live
news feed , online chat etc.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
● Interned at this company providing motion insights and visual telematics
services for vehicles.
● Developed core android applications using Media Codec libraries and
implemented a snapchat like video feature.
● Worked on remote servers like node.js, FCM push notifications and also
designed and implemented a new data transaction architecture.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
● Interned at this software company which provides on click services to
different clients.
● Worked on Artificial Intelligent Chat Bot System using Node.js, Wit.ai, Tomcat
server and also implemented push notification feature to their Android app.

projects.title: Risk prediction and Analysis in real-time health monitoring systems
projects.description:
"Risk prediction and Analysis in real-time health monitoring systems" which
involves a great deal of patients data analysis and currently involves working with
algorithms such as "Random forest decision trees" and "Multi-class neural
networks".

projects.title: Library Management Project
projects.description:
To make an android app for the university library using node.js and
SQL as a backend which helps the users to issue the books from the library on
the click of the button and sends notifications and alerts.
